title: Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition brings gridiron action to Apple Arcade on August 6
content: Apple Arcade grows its roster of hit sports games with the addition of EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 and more coming in August.

title: Apple and Major League Baseball announce August “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
content: Apple and Major League Baseball unveiled the August schedule for “Friday Night Baseball,” the weekly doubleheader streaming every Friday on Apple TV.

title: Apple scores record 89 Emmy Award nominations
content: Apple scored a historic 89 nominations across 15 programs for the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.

title: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
content: Apple announced a new six-year commitment with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies.

title: Apple Creator Studio gets smarter, faster, and more connected
content: Apple today introduced power-packed updates to Apple Creator Studio, a groundbreaking collection of creative apps.

title: Apple announces changes to iOS in Brazil
content: Apple today announced changes impacting iOS apps in Brazil that reflect a recent agreement with Brazil’s competition regulator, CADE.

title: Apple unveils innovative features and intelligence experiences across services
content: With the 2027 software releases coming this fall, Apple is bringing powerful new features to services users.

title: Apple aids app development with new intelligence frameworks and advanced tools
content: Apple today introduced new intelligence capabilities, expanded productivity features in Xcode, and platform improvements.

title: Apple unveils next generation of Apple Intelligence, Siri AI, and more
content: Today, Apple previewed its upcoming software releases that will deliver the next generation of Apple Intelligence and introduce Siri AI.

title: Apple Intelligence brings powerful AI capabilities into everyday experiences
content: Apple unveils the next generation of Apple Intelligence, integrating powerful AI capabilities into iPhone, iPad, and Mac for more personal and helpful everyday experiences.

title: Apple introduces Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant
content: Apple introduces Siri AI, a profoundly more capable and personal assistant powered by Apple Intelligence, with personal context, world knowledge, and onscreen awareness.

title: Apple previews new child safety features
content: Apple previews new child safety features that give parents greater control over their kids’ content, communication, and device access time.

title: Due to DMA, Siri AI delayed in EU for iOS 27 and iPadOS 27
content: Due to the Digital Markets Act, Apple will not be able to ship Siri AI in the European Union with the release of iOS 27 and iPadOS 27.

title: Apple expands App Store capabilities to help developers grow and reach new users
content: New App Store capabilities will give developers more flexibility to market their apps, acquire users, and manage subscriptions.

title: Apple and Major League Baseball announce July “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
content: Apple and Major League Baseball have announced the July schedule for “Friday Night Baseball” on Apple TV, featuring several marquee matchups.

title: Mini Football Legends, Family Feud Pocket, and seven more hits join Apple Arcade
content: Apple Arcade’s award-winning catalog of more than 200 games is adding nine new games, including My Talking Tom 2+ and Coffee Inc 2+.

title: App Store ecosystem reaches $1.4 trillion as developers thrive globally
content: Apple today announced the global App Store ecosystem facilitated over $1.4 trillion in developer billings and sales in 2025.
